registers.label: Spare
lines: A father said, Go work today. One son said no, then went.
To you, O Lord, we lift our souls.
Turn, and live, says the Lord; I take no pleasure in death.
Lead us in your truth and teach us your paths.
We have said no with our lips and yes with our feet, and the other way round.
Remember not our sins; remember your mercy.
Come, let us worship the God who waits for our turning.
We come, turning toward God. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Lift your soul this morning like an offering in open hands, to the God who shows the sinner the way home.
To you, O Lord, we lift our souls.
We come like the son who said no and thought better of it, like tax collectors edging into the kingdom.
To you, O Lord, we lift our souls.
For God takes no pleasure in our dying, only in our turning; turn, and live.
To you, O Lord, we lift our souls.
Teach us your paths, lead us in your truth, and remember not the sins of our younger days.
To you, O Lord, we lift our souls.
So come, all who have turned and all who long to, and worship.
To you, O Lord, we lift our souls. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: One son said no, then turned and went to work.
We lift our souls to you.
Turn and live, says the Lord; I delight in no one's death.
We lift our souls to you.
Teach us your paths; remember not our sins.
We lift our souls to you.
Come, let us worship the God who waits.
We come, turning home. Amen.
